## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title and commits follow [Conventional Commits](../CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-messages).
- [ ] The change is scoped to one feature, fix, or documentation update.
- [ ] Tests or verification output are included for behavior changes.
- [ ] Public documentation is updated for user-facing changes.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an `[Unreleased]` entry for user-facing changes.
- [ ] No secrets, local credentials, generated build output, or machine-specific evidence files are included.
